description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller for managing customer option values in an admin panel. It provides endpoints for listing, creating, editing, saving, paginating, and deleting customer option values, including handling descriptions in multiple languages. It interacts with services for customer options and language management, and includes security annotations to restrict access to users with role 'CUSTOMER'.
